A rate can have an order cutoff. Before it, the card says “Order within 3 h 12 min for delivery tomorrow”, updated once a minute and never ticking seconds. When the cutoff passes, the estimate moves to the next business day on its own. The fastest paid option gets a small badge, and the cheapest one does too when it isn’t already free.

Shipping Methods & delivery dates for React
ShippingMethods

ShippingMethods is the delivery step of a checkout. Each option is a radio card that leads with the date it arrives, “Mon, Oct 26 – Wed, Oct 28” or “Tomorrow”, then the method and carrier, with the price on the right. Shoppers compare dates more easily than “3–5 business days”, so the block works out real dates from business days, skipping weekends and any holidays you pass.
